title: 幻想水滸伝II
sources: Headless replay from power-on: the opening scene's dialogue, its first choice with the cursor on each answer, the party notice, walking, and talking to a soldier outside; about 100 frames compared with the layout's reading

Played on a handheld in a libretro PCSX ReARMed build from power-on to the mountain path: 584 readings with no unmapped code, the speakers, a four-row page, the first question's answers and cursor, and the values of byte 0x21

The game's font in video memory, matched glyph by glyph against the first game's table (SLPS-00097); the other glyphs read from the dialogue on the disc, which is in plain codes, and against a reference 12-pixel font
notes: One 16-bit table for the whole game (tables/ps1/SLPM-86168.tbl): the code is the glyph's place in the font. The dialogue is on the disc in plain codes (kana one byte, kanji two with a lead byte 01-03, 8 above the table's code) under CDROM/, so a scan in a standard encoding finds nothing. Not reached in the replay: towns, shops, battles, the war and duel screens. Window frame pieces, cursor marks and item icons (0x00-0x0F, 0x38-0x3B, 0xF2-0xF7) are not mapped.
